hero.headline: Polish psychotherapy in Dublin
hero.subline: 23 years of experience. Working with adults, children, couples and families.

intro.body: I am a psychologist and psychotherapist. For 23 years I have supported adults, children, couples and families through difficult moments in life. I work in Polish, in Dublin and online.

impact.quote: Change is possible — even when it's hard to believe right now.
impact.quote_sub: Psychotherapy is a safe space where you can work through difficulties and discover how to live more fully.
impact.stat_body: of people who begin psychotherapy experience significant, lasting improvement in their wellbeing.

approach.heading: Every dialogue begins with listening
approach.p1: I work within the psychodynamic tradition — an approach based on the understanding that what we experience today has its roots in the past. Together we examine these connections to understand where difficulties come from and how to work through them.
approach.p2: Therapy is not ready-made prescriptions or quick fixes. It is a space where you can speak about what matters — without judgement, at your own pace. My role is to accompany you in this work with attentiveness and respect.
approach.p3: The name 'Dialog' is not accidental. I believe that change begins with conversation — with a therapist, with those close to us, but above all with oneself.

I am a psychologist and psychotherapist with 23 years of clinical experience. I graduated in psychology from SWPS University in Warsaw, then completed a five-year adult psychotherapy school and a two-year child and adolescent psychotherapy school at the Kraków Psychodynamic Centre.

I work with adults, children, adolescents, couples and families. I specialise in psychodynamic psychotherapy — an approach that helps understand how past experiences shape the present.

I have run a private practice in Dublin for many years, where I am available to Polish-speaking patients living in Ireland.
